property_summary: After any call to addToBalance (whether it succeeds or reverts), the internal lock must eventually be released so that a subsequent call to withdrawBalance does not revert due to a locked guard. The buggy modifier requires locked_ to be true to enter, so the initial addToBalance reverts, never sets locked_ to false, and a later withdrawBalance always reverts.
change_summary: Replace the assertion require(!locked_) with a negation require(locked_), inverting the reentrancy guard logic so the function can only be called when locked is already true (i.e., during reentrancy or after lock is manually set).
